title: Publication Reference Release
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.18 — End-to-End Reliability, Performance Profiling & Integration QA
database_migration: No schema changes. All six protected scientific/reporting databases remain on their 11.18 schemas.
headline_features: Frozen publication-reference identifier and citation/archive metadata.
Deterministic synthetic reference project and reproducible example outputs.
Publication-ready architecture/workflow/demo figures in PNG and SVG.
Exact dependency reference lock plus target-environment freeze helper.
Source-tree SHA-256 manifest and publication-specific release verification.
Publication-safe source-only archive builder that excludes user data and installed country datasets.
Schema-only SQL exports for all six protected databases to document the frozen data architecture without publishing user rows.
scientific_boundaries: Synthetic demo values are not empirical agricultural evidence.
Publication reference identity does not imply scientific validation.
No DOI is claimed until the exact archive is deposited externally.
limitations: Full interactive Streamlit browser verification and genuine UI screenshots require the target Windows/Anaconda environment.
The bundled dependency lock should be complemented by the exact pip-freeze snapshot from the environment actually used for manuscript analyses.
An external DOI must be minted after final archive deposition.
